partition_name: birds (alternative: Jetz et al. 2012 (9,993 sp, 1000-tree posterior))
conflict_note: RESOLVED - otl_pipeline_involvement = none. S6 says none, S7 says collection-backed; S7 is wrong. The flag is defined (manuscript L59) as whether Open Tree SYNTHESIS SOFTWARE or taxonomy-backed grafting contributed to the shipped tree. Jetz 2012 used a Hackett/Ericson backbone with the authors own PASTIS-style constraint placement: no OTL software, no OTT taxonomy. S7 justifies its flag only by the tree being available in Open Tree of Life as a collection-backed reference tree - presence in the corpus, not contribution to construction. Applied consistently that rule would also recode mammals (ot_1990), amphibians (ot_1732), turtles (ot_3063), fish (ot_1592), seed plants (ot_1974) and bryozoa (ot_3052), all of which every table codes none. CONSEQUENCE: Jetz 2012 is a VALID substitution target under the manuscript own substitution workflow, so birds can contribute 6670 of 9993 molecular tips rather than zero. Deposited raw/birds/AllBirdsHackett1.tre: 9993 leaves, root-to-tip CV 0.00000 -> chronogram, hence point_dated; the birdtree.org 10000-tree posterior is NOT in the deposit, so divergence_ci_available=no.
